newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Golden Cross says grades encouraging.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Golden Cross says grades encouraging.

text.p: Australian gold explorer Golden Cross Resources NL intersected grades of up to 6.72 grams of gold a tonne (g/t) in drilling at the West Wyalong prospect in New South Wales (NSW) in the December quarter, the company said on Wednesday.
Grades ranged from 2.23 grams a tonne, it said.
The Mallee Bull line at the historic prospect had produced gold ore at an average recovered grade of 55 g/t, it said.
The company described results as encouraging in its quarterly report to December 31.
The company also acquired a 1.25 million tonne polymetallic indicated resource at Wagga Tank, NSW, it said.
The indicated resource showed 0.66 g/t gold, 0.81 percent copper, 1.76 percent lead, 3.29 percent zinc and 69 g/t silver, it said.
